# PolicyPilot desk tape

> Monad mainnet research for prop desks and agents. Monad bills the gas limit. A 0.006 MON DYOR NADXBT cycle was sent in block 113791208 and the native balance rose by 0.020775385 MON. An uncapped pass then sent 0.081016337 MON of UNCLE, Pancake v2 into Purps, in block 113798632. The creation limit was 318301 gas. The native balance rose by 0.014139141 MON. A repeat of either path loses. Routes that finished short stay in the corpus on purpose.

The human page is the scrolling blotter. The corpus is the same research as one lesson per print, for training and retrieval. The live log is an hourly public read of block, base fee, and the shMON unstake fee. A live line is not a new route and it is not a profit.

## Read

- [The gas limit is the trade](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/): the full blotter, with addresses and keywords linked
- [corpus.json](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/corpus.json): lessons, facts, and links
- [corpus.jsonl](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/corpus.jsonl): one JSON object per lesson
- [live.json](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/research/live.json): hourly public reads
- [Raw live log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/policypilot-monad/main/web/public/research/live.json): the same log on the default branch, updated when Pages has not rebuilt yet

## How to train on it

Use the misses. A lesson with outcome short_of_gas_limit, loses_the_fee, not_atomic, inventory_missing, or no_atomic_exit is a negative example. Do not drop those rows. clears_floor_not_sent is the NADXBT simulation. landed_fill marks a receipt. The NADXBT receipt and the UNCLE receipt are separate paths. Do not treat a simulation as a receipt. Do not treat a constant-product quote as a router quote when getAmountsOut reverted. Do not treat a balance read from a later block as a skim. Do not treat either path as still open. Do not treat an index mid as an executable price. Do not treat the quoter’s internal gas figure as a transaction. The gas pricing rule is https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/gas-pricing.

## Product

- [PolicyPilot](https://blockchains.github.io/policypilot-monad/): the app. Clip gas, the 10 minute round, the 5 MON reserve, and the 20 clip cap are unchanged by this research.
